detail: Reconciled after-the-fact (session had crashed): broker shows no SPY position and no open orders as of 2026-09-28 22:22 UTC. SPY closed at $765.61 vs the $766 strike, so the call almost certainly expired worthless (OTM by $0.39) rather than being sold by the agent -- all 4 SELL_TO_CLOSE attempts during the stop-loss sequence (14:59:17-15:00:11 UTC) confirmed CANCELLED/filled 0, and the process crashed on an uncaught 429 before a 5th attempt or exit_failed could be logged. Treat this as a $196 loss (entry $1.96 x1 contract x100, expired worthless), not the intended ~$98 50%-stop loss -- the stop fired correctly but never executed.
